Officer's narrative
On arrival in Pearland, Texas, I found a rear-end collision involving two vehicles. Driver 1 was stopped in the travel
lane when the vehicle operated by Driver 2 struck the rear of it. Driver 2 reported neck pain consistent with whiplash
and said they were seated in the vehicle at the time of impact. I confirmed that Driver 2 was present in the vehicle
when I arrived. The damage to both vehicles lines up with the impact described by the drivers, and the reported injury
fits the force of a collision of this type. Scene photographs show several of the details the parties described. No
independent witnesses were located, so the account rests on the statements of the drivers, the Passenger, and the
physical evidence. Driver 1 is the named insured on the policy for the vehicle they were operating. Neither driver
reported any prior damage to their vehicle, and none was visible during the inspection. The Passenger reported no
injuries at the scene. Both drivers were cooperative, and I issued the citation described in the attached supplement.
</page>
